title: European privacy fines: documented decisions and amounts per resident
description: Frozen collection of 1042 documented decisions across ten countries. Collection as of 2026-10-25; population on 1 January 2026. Unequal periods, mixed legal regimes, missing amounts and recorded appeal stages retained. Not a national census or enforcement-risk ranking. Study: https://www.legiscope.com/blog/amendes-rgpd-europe-comparaison-pays.html.
